title.narrative: Beijing Intelligent Manufacturing (Robotics) and Digital Economy Center of Excellence (CoE)

description.narrative: Drawing upon UNIDO#s extensive expertise and experience in implementing technical cooperation projects focused on the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR), digital transformation, and related frontier technologies, the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology approached UNIDO with a request to explore collaboration for a joint establishment of a Centre of Excellence on Robotics and Intelligent Manufacturing (Municipal Bureau#s letter dated 13 October 2025). The proposal aims to establish an Intelligent Manufacturing (Robotics) and Digital Economy Center of Excellence (CoE) in Beijing. Specifically, the CoE is intended to address the digital divide by boosting robotics research, innovation, and production in the region. The project's objective is to improve technological uptake in specific sectors and provide local entrepreneurs with exposure to robotics to help them develop new business models. It also aims to foster an environment that supports small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) by providing them with access to innovative technologies, digital skills, and business literacy.
